Scene-long target blocking; Jaw Lock blocks both participants until either leaves or faints; normal/forced Switcher effects are prevented. Target exit ends its block; ordinary source departure does not end a whole-scene effect. Run Away remains immune.

Ten standard four-round ongoing moves: 2 typeless dice at round end, defenses ignored, first ongoing source only. Blocking is separate; Clamp blocks both participants. Source-defined evasion difficulty remains GM discretion. Cleanse removes the matching ongoing trap, not independent scene blocks.

Magma Storm: four-round Blocking and 3 Fire-type damage dice at round end. Salt Cure: four-round 2 typeless dice, super-effective initial damage against Steel/Water and 1 extra ongoing damage against either type. Existing first-source priority and type/protection precedence are retained.

68 ordinary Physical/Special attacks: existing accuracy, reaction, damage, targeting and printed attribute machinery is retained; no additional native effect exists. Complete the attack after damage while preserving optional item effects. Lethal wounds and narrative clauses remain excluded.

Ten unconditional damaging stat clauses. Uses existing exact Chance pools, six-only success, ability/item modifiers, target protection, reflection, source-owned self changes and nonstacking stat channels.

Eight Support stat cards: exact printed recipients, typing/weather predicates, non-Ghost Curse, battlefield Grass recipients and Coaching excluding the user. Meditate follows its prose Special/Sp. Defense rather than the inconsistent structured Strength field. Existing stat-protection and nonstacking channels remain.

Ten attacks with defense/critical/weather rules: ignores defenses, Special damage resisted with Defense without changing category, existing AlwaysCrit and Weather Ball type/+2 weather dice. Ordinary completion retains held-item effects; historical adoption stays unchanged.

Eleven Accuracy-success reductions, including five exact Chance pools and Spacial Rend minus five. Reduces successes, not pool dice. Strongest loss applies without stacking; scene-local lifecycle, Keen Eye, Clear Amulet, Mirror Armor, decoys, shields and Shield Dust retained. Narrative effects remain GM-managed.

Four explicitly stacking stat cards: Sharpen, Syrup Bomb, Luster Purge and Mist Ball. Each named stat effect stacks to three; exact Chance pools, live reflection/protection and standard other-move nonstacking channels remain. Scene-local counters clear with modifiers or departure.

Rapid Spin raises user Dexterity and clears its ongoing damage/Leech Seed and its side hazards/terrains. Ice Spinner and Steel Roller remove active terrains; Steel Roller requires a terrain at declaration. Cleanup retains opposing side effects and pure scene Blocking, including shared/global scopes.

Seven source/context attacks. Current source main/secondary typing determines four move types; Terrain Pulse takes the active applicable terrain type and two dice; Psyblade gains two dice in Electric Terrain; Acrobatics loses two pool dice while holding an item. Existing STAB, immunity, resistance, snapshots and ability conversions retained.

Five stat/Blocking cards. Belly Drum rolls half current HP as typeless self-damage dice; Clangorous Soul half total HP rounded down; Fillet Away deals two self damage. No Retreat blocks the user and Octolock blocks the target independently of protected stat changes. Ordinary indirect protection and stat channels retained.

Taunt prevents Support Pokemon moves for four rounds while preserving Support Maneuvers. Throat Chop prevents Sound moves for the scene across switching. Imprison prevents foes from using the active caster's current known moves and ends on caster departure/faint. Authority, immunity and GM clearing remain explicit.

Four history-dependent moves with saved accepted Pokemon move attempts and entry rounds. Disable selects only the last recorded target move and replaces its prior disable; Torment excludes last-round moves for four rounds; Blood Moon/Gigaton Hammer fail if used last round, including Clash attempts. Gigaton Hammer's discretionary Steel bonus remains an explicit GM pool modifier.

Four shield-bypassing attacks retain exact printed attributes. Mighty Cleave also bypasses Force Fields; Hyperspace Hole/Fury retain existing Force Field bypass; Hyper Drill still takes applicable Force Field reduction. Hyperspace Fury reduces user Defense by one. Other weather/environment reductions remain.

Nine range/immunity attacks. Existing specific charge vulnerabilities retained; canonical Freeze Dry resolves the Dive card's Freeze-Dry spelling and is super-effective against Water. Origin Pulse/Precipice Blades hit hidden charging targets and ignore immunity to their printed damage type. Smack Down/Thousand Arrows remove Ground immunity for the scene, ending on departure. Weather activation guards, Shields and Force Fields remain independent.

Four completion routes for existing mechanics. Cut and Strength finish ordinary damage; outside-battle narrative/lifting and lethal wounds stay excluded. Strength preserves its reviewed canonical/legacy names. Fling/Natural Gift retain existing owned item preparation, physical-unit consumption, rarity/flavor/Ripen, hit effects, immunity, rollback and privacy; valid committed moves finish after damage and history-free probes explicitly request preparation.

Four partner attacks: Baddy Bad/Glitzy Glow create four-round own-side Physical/Special Force Fields only after dealing damage; Pika Papow adds Happiness dice capped at five; Zippy Zap retains guaranteed Critical and Reaction 2. Current encounters also correct the three already-routed partner moves' final-stage guard using forward ordinary evolution, excluding From/Mega/Form/same-Dex edges. Historical guard behavior is preserved. Baddy Bad follows Single Target prose rather than its inconsistent battlefield Target metadata.

Tailwind gives own-side Dexterity +2 through the non-additive move stat channel for four rounds, including entrants; Fairy Lock Blocks everyone on the battlefield for one round. Field duration persists without the caster; ordinary Run Away and GM switch override rules apply. Active timed fields cannot restart their counter by recasting (RULING p.77).

Spider Web installs a scene-long foe-side entry hazard. New entrants receive scene Blocking, including flying targets; current occupants are unaffected. Heavy-Duty Boots and Run Away retain their separate protections. Hazard cleanup removes the field, while already applied Blocking follows its own lifetime.

Complete ordinary Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade and Dynamax Cannon damage with their existing printed attributes; Dynamax/Gigantamax bonuses and lethal wounds remain excluded. Grassy Glide gains its printed Reaction 1 only while applicable Grassy Terrain is active, then finishes after ordinary damage.

First Impression is allowed only in the first round its deployed user can act: max(saved deployment round, available_round). User ruling 5 November 2026. Actual deployment history is saved; missed eligibility does not postpone the window. Reaction 2 remains. Missing saved entry history requires explicit review; historical encounters retain their prior manual scope.

Aura Wheel raises its user Dexterity by one through the existing damaging-stat channel, retaining Hunger Switch Full-Belly Electric/Hangry Dark typing, including the frozen damage/type pipeline. Existing protection, Sheer Force and stat abilities apply. Historical encounters retain manual effect completion.

Mud Sport and Water Sport create non-refreshable four-round global fields. Resolved damaging Electric/Fire moves have Power zero and cannot deal super-effective damage; resistance, immunity, STAB and independent extra dice remain. Damage and effect-immunity checks share the same sport-adjusted matchup. Historical encounters retain their previous behavior.

Tar Shot reduces target Dexterity by one using ordinary stat protection/reflection, and independently makes damaging Fire-type moves super-effective against it for the scene. Existing type/ability immunity remains; Water Sport still suppresses super-effective damage. Recall/faint clears the scene mark. Historical encounters retain manual resolution.
